description: CharXiv-style binary-scored probes adapted to our figures. Uses their 19 descriptive question templates + hard reasoning categories (counting, computing, intersection detection). Binary scoring: exact match = 1, wrong = 0.
methodology: Adapted from CharXiv (princeton-nlp). Questions have single correct answers for binary grading.
